pretreatments.description: Shredding operation (I-PT) - Low speed knife mill with water/TS ratio 10:1, reduces particle size
Shredding and Mixing operation (II-PT) - Combines shredding with water addition (10:1), favors organic compound extraction, pulping operation
Shredding, Mixing and Blending operation (III-PT) - Combines shredding, mixing and fine blending (like wet grinders), alters lignocellulosic structure, creates homogeneous liquid slurry
Hammer Mill - Mobile hammer mill (Noremat Valormax BA915D) at full-scale site La Bouzule
Hammer Mill - Fixed hammer mill (unknown device, on-line) at full-scale site
Chain mill (X-Chopper) at full-scale site METHELEC - Xergi brand, 10:1 water/TS ratio
